mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, measure_time, total_cholesterol, triglycerides, hdl, ldl FROM t_blood_lipid WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_blood_lipid (user_id, device_id, measure_time, total_cholesterol, triglycerides, hdl, ldl) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{measureTime}, #{totalCholesterol}, #{triglycerides}, #{hdl}, #{ldl})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_blood_lipid SET user_id=#{userId}, device_id=#{deviceId}, measure_time=#{measureTime}, total_cholesterol=#{totalCholesterol}, triglycerides=#{triglycerides}, hdl=#{hdl}, ldl=#{ldl} WHERE id=#{id}
